surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the adsorption of CMEN-Zr precursor and oxygen plasma, leading to the formation of ZrO2. The mechanism includes the ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups, followed by a water pulse to regenerate OH sites.
